'''''Homalomena''''' is a [[genus]] of flowering plants in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Araceae]]. ''Homalomena'' are native to tropical Asia and China.<ref name=POWO/><ref>Govaerts, R. & Frodin, D.G. (2002). World Checklist and Bibliography of Araceae (and Acoraceae): 1-560. The Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew.</ref><ref>Boyce, P.C. & Wong, S.Y. (2009). Studies on Homalomeneae (Araceae) of Borneo IV: ''Homalomena'' specimens in the herbarium Beccarianum-Malesia (FI-B) of the Museo di Storia Naturale - Sezione Botanica "F.Parlatore" dell'Università di Firenze. Webbia; Raccolta de Scritti Botanici 64: 169-173.</ref> Many ''Homalomena'' have a strong smell of [[anise]]. The name derives apparently from a mistranslated Malayan vernacular name, translated as {{Transliteration|ms|homalos}}, meaning flat, and ''mene'' = moon.

The plants of this genus are clump-forming evergreen perennials with mainly heart-shaped or arrowheaded shaped leaves. The flowers are tiny and without petals, enclosed in a usually greenish [[spathe]] hidden by the leaves.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=115676 |title=Flora of China Vol. 23 Page 17, <big>千年健属</big> qian nian jian shu, ''Homalomena'' Schott in Schott & Endlicher, Melet. Bot. 20. 1832. |access-date=16 August 2014 |archive-date=15 October 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131015060010/http://efloras.org/florataxon.aspx?flora_id=2&taxon_id=115676 |url-status=live }}</ref>

Some authors have proposed splitting the genus and moving all the [[neotropics|neotropical]] species of ''Homalomena'' to ''[[Adelonema]].''<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.aroid.org/genera/generapage.php?genus=homalomena |title=Aroid genera |access-date=1 March 2010 |archive-date=17 February 2010 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100217022911/http://www.aroid.org/genera/generapage.php?genus=homalomena |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.aroid.org/genera/130307uberlist.pdf |title=The Überlist of Araceae, 2013 |access-date=5 July 2013 |archive-date=5 July 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130705172714/http://www.aroid.org/genera/130307uberlist.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40032219 |title=Tropicos, Missouri Botanical Garden |access-date=16 August 2014 |archive-date=19 August 2014 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140819094015/http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40032219 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://araceum.abrimaal.pro-e.pl/pages/sys.htm |title=The Systematics of Araceae |access-date=5 July 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20121119023820/http://araceum.abrimaal.pro-e.pl/pages/sys.htm |archive-date=19 November 2012 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
